title: Lilac Ribbed Top & Patterned Trousers
prompt: An original young woman with long, sleek brown hair pulled back holds a patterned mug while seated cross-legged on a sage floral sofa. She wears a lavender ribbed turtleneck, layered silver chains, and gold hoop earrings. Her patterned purple-and-brown knit trousers and chunky pale sneakers complete the look. Soft morning light from a sheer curtain. Palette of lilac, sage, and warm gold. Cozy and nostalgic, in the style of a 1990s film still.
workingNotes:
- The layered chains and patterned trousers are the signature styling.
- Use 'soft film grain' for a vintage feel.
tryThis: Try this: Add soft film grain.
